text.text: IBM Flash System® V9000 offers the advantages of software-defined storage at the speed of flash memory, with all-flash storage arrays that combine the high performance, ultra-low latency, superior efficiency and enterprise reliability of IBM FlashCore technology.

graphic.text: IBM Flash System® V9000 offers the advantages of software-defined storage at the speed of flash memory, with all-flash storage arrays that combine the high performance, ultra-low latency, superior efficiency and enterprise reliability of IBM FlashCore technology.

text.text: Enterprise class storage system: Scale to 2.5M IOPS and 2.2PB of effective capacity 2.4TB – 57TB usable capacity per storage enclosure; up to 285TB effective capacity per storage enclosure for active data sets using Real-Time Compression Advanced storage functionality with the two FlashSystem V9000 Control enclosures 8Gb Fibre Channel, 16Gb Fibre Channel, or 10Gb FCoE/iSCSI connectivity 6U form factor including two 2U Control enclosures and one 2U Storage enclosure

graphic.text:
Enterprise class storage system:

Scale to 2.5M IOPS and 2.2PB of effective capacity

2.4TB – 57TB usable capacity per storage enclosure; up to 285TB effective capacity per storage enclosure for active data sets using Real-Time Compression

Advanced storage functionality with the two FlashSystem V9000 Control enclosures

8Gb Fibre Channel, 16Gb Fibre Channel, or 10Gb FCoE/iSCSI connectivity

6U form factor including two 2U Control enclosures and one 2U Storage enclosure

text.text: Real-Time Compression™: improve efficiency and control storage costs by increasing the effective capacity up to 5 times IBM Easy Tier®: automatically migrate data between storage tiers Data virtualization: insulate applications from physical changes to your storage environment Thin provisioning: enable dynamic growth, purchase only the storage you need when you need it Highly available configurations: enable near-continuous data availability Copy Services: provide space efficient backups Quality of Service: help alleviate performance contention Global and Metro mirroring: full set of disaster recovery tools with synchronous and asynchronous mirroring Non-disruptive data migrations: maintain concurrent I/O while moving data between storage systems

graphic.text:
Real-Time Compression™: improve efficiency and control storage costs by increasing the effective capacity up to 5 times

IBM Easy Tier®: automatically migrate data between storage tiers

Data virtualization: insulate applications from physical changes to your storage environment

Thin provisioning: enable dynamic growth, purchase only the storage you need when you need it

Highly available configurations: enable near-continuous data availability

Copy Services: provide space efficient backups

Quality of Service: help alleviate performance contention

Global and Metro mirroring: full set of disaster recovery tools with synchronous and asynchronous mirroring

Non-disruptive data migrations: maintain concurrent I/O while moving data between storage systems

text.text: IBM FlashCore™ technology: Combines high performance, ultra-low latency, cost-efficiency and extreme reliability with a rich set of the storage features found in advanced Tier 1 storage solutions Superior data economics: Accelerates time to value through agile, easy-to-implement, fully integrated solution architectures Feature rich, software-defined storage layer: Virtualizes and extends the functionality of all managed storage IBM MicroLatency™: Delivers microsecond response time to accelerate critical applications and achieve competitive advantages Enterprise reliability: Provides fully redundant, hot-swappable components; multiple RAID layers; AES-XTS 256 encryption; and concurrent code upgrades for maximizing uptime and availability Single point of control for storage resources: designed to increase management efficiency and help support business application availability Increase storage utilization: pools the storage capacity of multiple storage systems on a SAN Easy-to-use IBM Storwize family management interface: a single interface for storage configuration, management and service tasks, regardless of storage vendor

graphic.text:
IBM FlashCore™ technology: Combines high performance, ultra-low latency, cost-efficiency and extreme reliability with a rich set of the storage features found in advanced Tier 1 storage solutions

Superior data economics: Accelerates time to value through agile, easy-to-implement, fully integrated solution architectures

Feature rich, software-defined storage layer: Virtualizes and extends the functionality of all managed storage

IBM MicroLatency™: Delivers microsecond response time to accelerate critical applications and achieve competitive advantages

Enterprise reliability: Provides fully redundant, hot-swappable components; multiple RAID layers; AES-XTS 256 encryption; and concurrent code upgrades for maximizing uptime and availability

Single point of control for storage resources: designed to increase management efficiency and help support business application availability

Increase storage utilization: pools the storage capacity of multiple storage systems on a SAN

Easy-to-use IBM Storwize family management interface: a single interface for storage configuration, management and service tasks, regardless of storage vendor

text.text: IBM FlashSystem™ V840 Enterprise Performance Solution amplifies the economics of flash so that businesses get more capacity without sacrificing cost or performance. This system enhances the performance, efficiency, connectivity and reliability essential to enterprise applications and solutions.
